activity.notes: Tlacaelel rose during the late-1420s war against Azcapotzalco and held the senior cihuacoatl office of Tenochtitlan across several tlatoani reigns until his death in 1487. He was not an Aztec emperor, so ATLAS binds the office specifically to Mexico-Tenochtitlan within the Triple Alliance.

sources.title: Tlacaelel — Nahuatl Dictionary
sources.citation_text: The University of Oregon Nahuatl Dictionary identifies Tlacaelel as a ruler/statesman of Mexico-Tenochtitlan who held the title cihuacoatl.

sources.title: Tlacaelel
sources.citation_text: The compiled chronology places his rise to the cihuacoatl/principal-adviser role in the late 1420s and records his death in 1487.
